CustomField.description: Whether an active template has a pending run due on or before today, within its End Date. Used for complete recurring overview counts.
CustomField.formula: AND(Active__c, NOT(ISBLANK(Next_Run_Date__c)), Next_Run_Date__c <= TODAY(), OR(ISBLANK(End_Date__c), Next_Run_Date__c <= End_Date__c))
CustomField.label: Due for Generation
